Name: Tiny Lucia
Description: Commandant accessory. Obtained after completing specified Whispers of Love Story.
WorldDescription: She gently grips the fabric at your side, peeking her head out from the edge. Tiny as she is, she never forgets to keep watch over the surroundings. "Commandant, it looks like someone over there needs help. Let's go check it out."

Name: Tiny Liv
Description: Commandant accessory. Obtained after completing the specified Invitation Mission.
WorldDescription: She holds you close, gently brushing away the pain of the past. "Commandant, please take care of yourself. Just like this. Safe and steady, side by side..."

Name: Tiny Selena
Description: Commandant accessory. Obtained after completing the specified Invitation Mission.
WorldDescription: Cherishing this moment by your side. Like the sky clearing after rain, it's happiness in its simplest form. "A pause free of worries, a breath amid a busy journey. I want to spend it just like this, with you."

Name: Tiny Lee
Description: Commandant accessory. Obtained after completing the specified Invitation Mission.
WorldDescription: I'm still not fully comfortable with the tracker. Keeping things this way lets me monitor your safety more effectively. Lee says this with his usual certainty.

Name: Tiny Kamui
Description: Commandant accessory. Obtained after completing the specified Invitation Mission.
WorldDescription: The little guy swings his legs as he snuggles close in your arms, eyes sparkling with excitement. "There are so many fun and happy times I want to experience with Commandant! I'm not going anywhere—I'm going to stick close to you!"

Name: Tiny Alpha
Description: Commandant accessory. Obtained after completing the specified Invitation Mission.
WorldDescription: Though the handcuffs have been removed, that doesn't mean the connection will simply fade away. The tiny traces left behind from their first meeting have already grown deeper and more intricate than they could have ever imagined, quietly taking root and spreading outward with the little her as the starting point.

Name: Raven Regalia
Description: Commander costume. No acquisition method available yet. Stay tuned.
WorldDescription: A formal attire custom-tailored for the medal ceremony. To showcase the Gray Raven Commandant's leading role, the shoulder boards and mask feature patterns incorporating the squad's insignia, while the feather motifs add a certain sharpness to the solemn ceremony.
